# Tano Core 0.10.0

Prepared on 2026-11-06. This release ships the five @tano.page npm packages
and the tano-native crate as one MIT-licensed release set.

- Add identity-only object references while retaining readers for existing
  references, mention-driven Agent interactions, folder home navigation,
  document conversion and editable spreadsheet support.
- Add multi-block source editing, clipboard format and math recognition
  preferences, composable appearance themes, printing and configurable shortcuts.
- Improve large-document and workspace loading, tab animation and docking,
  file icons, feature guidance, assistant connections and usage information.
- Simplify note translation with contextual target selection and explicit
  language requests taking priority.
- Preserve folder tabs, split layouts and document drafts in native session
  recovery, rejecting malformed folder identities before replacing recovery data.
- Resolve theme font variables to concrete Word font names; align reference
  insertion coverage with the identity-only format.
- Refine platform-specific link hints, breadcrumb alignment and link styling.

The coordinated Product release is cloud-only. This Core publication does not
publish replacement desktop installers or update the Microsoft Store package.
Local validation and exact source identity are recorded with the distribution.
